§ 01 · The Program

Real systems,
real decisions.

From implementing a new software system and responding to a cybersecurity breach, to adopting AI, migrating to the cloud, and leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, every scenario drops you into a genuine technology situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty implementation-and-adoption-focused scenarios and sixty security-, architecture-, and strategy-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real technology judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a technology or digital transformation professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across implementation, cybersecurity, cloud, AI and data, agile delivery, and digital strategy.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound technology judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

scenario.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Technology Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping technology and digital transformation professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in technology isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, technology and digital transformation roles in English — Mr. Gad Technology & Digital Transformation is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the technology moments you'll actually face.
